validation.governance_test: v1 and v2 register independently in a temporary isolated GovernanceStore; this validates the path only and is not a durable/runtime registration

protocol_checks.cycles: 30 non-overlapping development cycles plus 10 untouched forward holdout cycles; minimum completed cycle duration remains 14 days
protocol_checks.collection: 30-second polls, 20 levels per side, exact runner-consumed books, finite-depth actions only, 700-day collector target and at least 560 days after first entry

storage_model.basis: synthetic variable-book compressed-size estimate, not measured Deribit/VPS storage
storage_model.assessment: 5 GiB is a plausible planning quota for the compact single-writer design: it leaves about 2.76 GiB above the 2.241 GiB snapshot-plus-index proxy. It is not a proof of capacity. The measured effective retention horizon, live SQLite/WAL, metadata, settlements/corrections, manifests, compaction and clean-room restore must remain <=4 GiB retained and <5 GiB peak.

integration_snapshot.exact_runner_book_writer: Runner evidence recorder writes exact snapshots to market.sqlite3; separate DatedMarketCollector also polls and persists spot/future rows as kind=book at 30 seconds in the same database in the observed worktree.
integration_snapshot.forward_collection_gate: BLOCKED: 2 GiB config/unit quota does not match the v2 5 GiB quota; the collector still has a second periodic book writer in the observed worktree; representative storage forecast and clean-room restore are not evidenced.
integration_snapshot.runtime_registration_or_collection: NOT VERIFIED; no VPS action or forward collection was performed by this research lot

proof_boundary: Fixtures and governance tests prove deterministic protocol construction and mechanics only. They do not establish durable fill archival, runner/collector parity in deployment, market profitability, account-specific fees, or production capacity.
